concept_summary: Shepherd moves software specs through delivery gates: one spec, one branch, one pull request at a time, with the fold kept closed behind each one. The mark is a chamfered two-tone frame — the gate — holding the S.
palette_summary: Furrow: moss acts (buttons, focus, the mark's stroke) and umber holds (structure, the mark's ground). Two light accents — wheat for warmth on paper, spring for lift on moss and dark ground — and lake blue reserved for information. The four status colours never change.
